info.name: SecureApp API — DPoP + Session Auth
info.description:
Complete API test collection for SecureApp.

Security model: Session-based authentication + DPoP (Demonstration of Proof-of-Possession) binding.

Request flow: Client → DPoPAuthenticationFilter → SessionValidationFilter → AuthorizationInterceptor → Controller

Public endpoints: /auth/login, /auth/register, /auth/logout, /health
Protected endpoints: Require valid JSESSIONID cookie + DPoP proof header

## DPoP Pre-Request Script
Login and protected endpoint requests include pre-request scripts that automatically generate ECDSA P-256 keypairs and DPoP proof JWTs using the jsrsasign library.

The keypair is generated once at login and stored in collection variables. Subsequent requests reuse the same private key to generate fresh proofs.

## Test Credentials
- Admin: admin / AdminPass123! (ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_USER)
- User: testuser / UserPass123! (ROLE_USER)

item.name: 4. Protected Endpoints (Session + DPoP)
item.description:
These requests require:
1. A valid JSESSIONID cookie (from successful login)
2. A fresh DPoP proof JWT in the DPoP header (signed with the same private key used at login)

Without both, the server returns 401 Unauthorized.

item.name: 5. DPoP Validation Tests
item.description:
Tests that verify DPoP enforcement on protected endpoints.

These tests ensure that:
- Missing DPoP header → 401
- Invalid/expired DPoP proof → 401
- Requests without a session → 401

item.name: 6. Session Validation Tests

These tests should be run AFTER logging out or with cleared cookies.

item.name: 7. Authorization Tests (Role-Based)
item.description:
End-to-end role-based access control tests.

Flow:
1. Login as USER → access dashboard (200) → access admin (403) → logout
2. Login as ADMIN → access dashboard (200) → access admin (200) → logout
3. Post-logout validation (401 on all protected endpoints)

Permission matrix:
- /dashboard/** → ROLE_USER, ROLE_ADMIN
- /admin/**     → ROLE_ADMIN only
